rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides direct access to Datto RMM through a comprehensive implementation that enables device management, alert monitoring, job scheduling, and audit operations. Part of a complete toolkit that includes auto-generated TypeScript and Rust API clients, the server handles OAuth authentication automatically and supports all six Datto RMM regional platforms (Pinotage, Merlot, Concord, Vidal, Zinfandel, Syrah). Useful for MSPs and IT administrators who want to query device status, resolve alerts, manage sites, and execute quick jobs without switching between interfaces.
